chains.title: null_model
predictions: ARID5B ChIP or EMSA signal at rs1421085 is genotype-independent in adipocytes.
IRX3/IRX5 expression is not allele-dependently regulated by rs1421085 in adipocytes.
falsified_if: Adipocyte ARID5B binding at rs1421085 differs between T and C alleles.
Adipocyte IRX3/IRX5 expression is allele-dependent at rs1421085.

chains.title: ARID5B_loss_derepresses_IRX3_IRX5

links.claim: ARID5B binds the T allele more strongly than the C allele at rs1421085; ARID5B is chosen from known adipocyte enhancer/motif literature over related TFs, and no evidence IDs are supplied here.
rs1421085 lies in an adipocyte enhancer in FTO intron 1.
Loss of ARID5B binding on the C allele increases IRX3 and IRX5 expression.
This occurs in subcutaneous adipocytes or pre-adipocytes.
Increased IRX3/IRX5 expression reduces thermogenesis and increases obesity risk.

predictions: ARID5B binds the T allele more strongly than the C allele at rs1421085.
The obesity-risk C allele associates with higher IRX3 and IRX5 expression in adipocytes.
falsified_if: ARID5B ChIP or EMSA shows no T-over-C binding difference at rs1421085.

chains.title: ARID5B_loss_increases_FTO_expression

links.claim: ARID5B binds the T allele more strongly than the C allele at rs1421085; ARID5B is chosen from known adipocyte enhancer/motif literature, with no evidence IDs supplied here.
rs1421085 lies in an adipocyte enhancer in FTO intron 1.
Loss of ARID5B binding on the C allele increases FTO expression.
This occurs in subcutaneous adipocytes or pre-adipocytes.
Increased FTO expression increases obesity risk.

predictions: ARID5B binds the T allele more strongly than the C allele at rs1421085.
FTO expression is higher on the C allele than on the T allele in adipocytes.
falsified_if: FTO expression is not allele-dependent at rs1421085 in adipocytes.

chains.title: CTCF_insulator_disruption

links.claim: CTCF binds the C allele more strongly than the T allele at rs1421085; no CTCF QBiC-SELEX model is cited here.
rs1421085 lies in an adipocyte insulator or enhancer element in FTO intron 1.
Altered CTCF binding changes IRX3/IRX5 chromatin insulation and expression.
This occurs in subcutaneous adipocytes or pre-adipocytes.
Altered IRX3/IRX5 expression changes thermogenesis and obesity risk.

predictions: CTCF binding at rs1421085 differs between the T and C alleles.
Altered CTCF occupancy changes IRX3/IRX5 insulation or expression in adipocytes.
falsified_if: CTCF ChIP shows no genotype-dependent binding at rs1421085.
